page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include bundled local storage or integrated graphics processing units (GPUs). Network connectivity does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because the CPU allocation is dedicated, the instance provides predictable compute resources without the performance variability associated with shared-core or burstable environments.

From a workload perspective, the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes the ecs.s2.xlarge suitable for entry-level general-purpose applications. These include lightweight web serving, small-scale application hosting, development environments, and basic utility services that require dedicated compute resources but do not demand high-performance storage or specialized hardware acceleration.
